fins.definition:
n the cardinal number that is the sum of four and one
n one of a pair of decorations projecting above the rear fenders of an automobile
n one of a set of parallel slats in a door or window to admit air and reject rain
n a shoe for swimming; the paddle-like front is an aid in swimming (especially underwater)
n a stabilizer on a ship that resembles the fin of a fish
n organ of locomotion and balance in fishes and some other aquatic animals
v equip (a car) with fins
v propel oneself through the water in a finning motion
v show the fins above the water while swimming
fins.translation: n. 鳍片, 散热翅片；五元纸币（fin的复数形式）

finsbury.translation: n. 芬斯伯里（（英国伦敦一区, 位于泰晤士河南岸）

finschhafen.translation: [地名] [巴布亚新几内] 芬什港

finsen bath.translation: [医] 芬森氏浴, 弧光浴

finsen lamp.translation:
[化] 芬生灯
[医] 芬森氏弧光灯(紫外线灯之一)

finsen light.translation: [医] 芬森氏光(主要为紫光及紫外线)

finsen method.translation: [医] 芬森氏法(治寻常狼疮)

finsen rays.translation: [医] 芬森氏光(主要为紫及紫外线)

finsen treatment.translation: [医] 芬森氏疗法(治寻常狼疮)

finsen's apparatus.translation: [医] 芬森氏[治疗]灯(紫外线灯之一种)

finsen's treatment.translation: [医] 芬森氏光疗法, 弧光疗法(治寻常狼疮)

finsen-reya lamp.translation: [医] 芬-雷二氏灯(改良的芬森氏弧光灯)

finsteraarhorn.translation: n. 芬斯特腊尔霍恩峰（位于瑞士西南 为伯尔尼山最高峰）
